limits: Raw reference packet columns and repeated/partial application views remain separate from logical application frames; no normalization or blanket parity claim.
Wire-only flags certify observed known STREAM bytes, not another decoded application message or peer delivery.
Arbitrary undecryptable packets, unobserved new STREAM prefixes and new connection generations do not borrow HTTP3 identity.

Other frame-placement/stream-creation errors, late request-method response reevaluation, full authority/URI/extension and QPACK dependency semantics, and overall protocol/field/fuzz completeness remain unfinished.
Windows still exposes some QUIC CID octets as IPC Base64; this newly observed display defect remains a separate follow-up.
